title: Figure 13: Mode Converter Vlasov Antenna and Vlasov Antenna Attached to a Coaxial MILO
description: Two-part line drawing: (a) a Vlasov antenna mode converter with a stepped-cut waveguide end and arrows showing the radiated beam direction; (b) a Vlasov antenna attached to a coaxial MILO, with labels "RF choke," "Slow wave structure," "Antenna," "Cathode," "Extractor" and "Bell jar (vacuum window)." The caption reads "Figure 13. (a) Mode Converter Vlasov Antenna and (b) Vlasov Antenna Attached to a Coaxial MILO." The text continues with wideband and ultrawideband antennas.
